pathAssistantSteps.info:
• You will receive a decision on your application.
  • Look at reworking deals for declined applications
  • Set follow-up dates for AST/AIP outcomes.
  • Update the waiting indicator to get the required information from the customer based on the conditions on AST/AIP notice.
  • Create tasks for follow-ups as required
  • Direct customer to perform KYC checks for Approved outcomes

• Your application is currently with Doc-Prep operations team for preparation of Letter of Offer pack
  • Set follow-up to ensure documents are returned prior to Offer Expiry and Approval Expiry.

• Book appointment with the customer and conduct customer interview(s)
  • Start Simpology application for serviceability, application capture, and supporting document requests. Your Simpology application will be in "Open" status at this stage
  • Order valuation(s)
  • Submit pricing request

• Confirm conveyancer details
  • Ensure customer completes the Loan Disbursement Order

• Your application is currently under assessment.Watch out for information requests from operations team
  • Update the waiting indicator if there are any pending requests with the customer based on insufficiency notice.
  • Create tasks for follow-ups as required
